title: moniera serpylloides
intro: Moniera serpylloides, commonly known as 'Indian pennywort', is a type of herbaceous plant belonging to the family Monimiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Moniera serpylloides include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
